notes: Repeatedly ran HQ to re-see the same NGO Fronts and ran into a known IP Block seven times with no breaker and no link. Never contested the advancing remote and let the Corp score out while sitting at 1-2 credits.

With an idle Runner for about 20 turns, the Corp banked 30+ credits on Gila and basic clicks, discarded every turn and scored only 3 points. It sank many advancements into Shattered Remains and left R&D behind a single Enigma until it was dug out.

Took 4 tags from Hard-Hitting News, cleared only one and then sat at 1 credit with 3 tags for several turns while running HQ every click. This was a foreseeable High-Profile Target flatline against a Corp with 17+ credits.
Built economy with Advanced Assembly Lines and scored efficiently from an iced remote. A few idle credit clicks, but the plan was clean against a passive Runner.
Steady R&D pressure with Aumakua won the game, but paid 9 for a Femme Fatale it never used. It often stayed tagged from Liza and later spent a whole turn clearing four tags.

Installed and advanced agendas behind unrezzed ice it could not afford, and Cyberdex Sandbox was stolen from the remote twice in a row. It then spent most turns clicking for credits with a full hand and discarding.
Grinding R&D with Paperclip won, but it twice ran HQ into a known Fairchild 2.0 with no breaker, losing Paperclip, Tech Trader and taking core damage. It sat on 1 card and 1-2 credits for many turns.

Clicked for credits about 60 times up to 69 credits and never installed a breaker. It never ran the naked remotes where the Corp installed and scored Project Atlas, two Hostile Takeovers and Global Food Initiative.
Advanced Ikawah behind unrezzed ice it could not afford to rez, and it was stolen. It played Biotic Labor only to click for credits and lost the last agenda in a remote the Runner could break into.
Scored steadily from the remote and won, but HQ had no ice early and gave up two agendas. Remote Enforcement was later stolen through a single Gatekeeper the Runner had already broken.
Fast scoring behind Fairchild 3.0 with Seamless Launch closed out the game quickly. Leaving R&D unprotected for many turns was risky but did not cost anything.

Sensible central pressure with Paperclip and Black Orchestra won the game. It stayed tagged for many turns, letting the Corp trash resources, ran low on credits all game and made several empty Archives runs.
Repeatedly played Audacity just to throw away its whole hand. Two Global Food Initiatives were stolen from the same remote while the Corp was too poor to defend it.

After an early R&D push it clicked for credits for six turns up to 31, never running while the Corp advanced and scored Send a Message and set up another remote. The final Loki run that flatlined it looks like an engine oddity, not a foreseeable blunder.

Aggressive and mostly good: trashed Regolith twice and stole Send a Message, Longevity Serum and Obokata for the win. It ran Loki with 1 credit and lost its whole hand, and later took a Mlinzi hit while broke.

Spent dozens of turns clicking for credits up to 59 with a full hand, discarding every turn, and lost Offworld Office and two Global Food Initiatives through breakable ice. It stalled one agenda short and decked out.

Quick, efficient win through HQ and R&D pressure with Paperclip and MKUltra. Small oddities: a double Moshing that pitched Daily Casts and Dirty Laundry, and paying to access a Marilyn without trashing it.

Left Fetal AI in a naked remote at 0 credits, where it was stolen, and kept agendas in a thinly iced HQ. It then lost the game by Mushin No Shin-ing House of Knives into an unprotected new remote while the Runner was on 6 points.

Lost Global Food Initiative on turn 1 behind ice it could not rez after Mining Accident, and left R&D open long enough to lose Cyberdex Sandbox. After that it scored steadily from an increasingly iced remote and won.

Reached 6 points by turn 4, then never ran the remote where a broke Corp advanced Project Vitruvius behind unrezzed ice, which was a winning steal. It spent the next nine turns clicking for credits up to 38 without installing anything.
